Co-Ed Council

Brotherhood serves as the medicine to integrate the sacred masculine with the feminine essence. We gather with our sisters to flourish as a communal hub honoring this connection.

The Way of We

Our Co-Ed Council is a space where men and women come together in honest dialogue, shared practice, and mutual healing. We believe the relationship between masculine and feminine is the great teacher — and that community is where that integration lives.

  • Monthly co-ed gathering circles
  • Relational healing practices
  • Communication and intimacy workshops
  • Community celebrations and seasonal gatherings

Why it matters

We are not meant to heal in silos. The masculine and feminine need one another to remember wholeness. This council is that reminder.
